name: @cloudsforge/tessera-assets
description: The Tessera art set, and the run that produced it. 392 assets under docs/ecosystem/23-tessera.md §2, generated by FLUX 2 Pro; images plus a provenance manifest. A Qwen-Image 2512 challenger was evaluated and withdrawn — COMPARISON.md keeps what that evaluation measured. The generation engine lives in the sibling studio service and is not duplicated here.
_noDependencies: This package has no dependencies and no node_modules of its own, on purpose.
generate.ts imports four modules from ../studio/src — backend, specs, sizing and the licence
constant from assets — and all of them are dependency-free, so nothing has to be installed
to read them. What those studio modules encode is every verified fact about the FLUX 2 Pro
endpoint, and each one cost a real request to learn. A second copy here would be a second
What is DIFFERENT here from the three sibling asset repositories: the canonical content is in
this repository rather than in a sibling service. micro-tessera does not exist yet, and doc
23 §6 puts the trees here so the engine and the art prompts read one file. plan.ts therefore
imports nothing outside this directory except the studio modules above.
The consequence is that this repository is NOT self-contained: a RUN needs ../studio beside
it. The ARTEFACTS are self-contained — the PNGs, MANIFEST.json, PLAN.json and content/ carry
everything needed to audit what was made and from what.
normalise_ground.py is pure standard library. cutout.py, project_iso.py, derive.py, sheet.py,
compare.py and verify.py need Pillow. Not sips: design-system.md §7 item 3 names sips as the
reason the estate's resize step once existed on exactly one laptop.

scripts._run: Run from the studio workspace so tsx resolves out of its node_modules.
